standouts.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: five clean waves up from Oct 17, 2022 to Mar 9 (+83%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−17% to −26%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Jun 24, 2024 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−37%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+15%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

material.text: On Oct 20 it closed above the top of a 6-week base (25% deep) after a +43% advance, on 2.2x average volume. 4 of the 4 closes from the break on held above the level it broke, and the break session closed 1.3 ATR past it on a 1.4-ATR range.

material.head: Confirmed double bottom

material.head: Support −4.5% below

KWR.gist: A stock in an uptrend below resistance (the Jan 15 high); a daily close above it starts the move.

standouts.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
standouts.text: On the weekly chart, price made a higher low the week of Sep 14 while 4 of 7 momentum gauges made a lower low (hidden bullish divergence).
standouts.learn: Price makes a higher low while momentum makes a lower low: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

standouts.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: five clean waves up from Apr 7, 2025 to Feb 17 (+91%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−17% to −27%), on lighter volume, with the Mar 16 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−38%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+17%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.head: Retesting its breakout level
standouts.text: It broke out above the July high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
standouts.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

standouts.head: Weekly chart: advancing
standouts.text: On the weekly chart price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
standouts.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.

standouts.head: In a 10-week base
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 10 weeks in a range 13% deep after a +25% advance.
standouts.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.

against.head: A descending triangle
against.text: Buyers have held the same floor twice while each bounce stops lower: pressure building on the floor.
against.learn: A flat floor with falling highs: sellers keep taking less.

against.head: MACD negative
against.text: MACD is below its signal line and below zero, with the histogram falling.
against.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; crossing above its signal line means momentum is turning up.

KWR.take: KWR: it is pulling back inside an uptrend, below resistance at the Jan 15 high; the buy waits for a daily close above it. Buyers are stepping in earlier (weekly), and it is turning up from its wave-2 zone on the weekly chart. Against it, there is a descending triangle. The desk is for it.
KWR.change: No trade until a daily close above +4.2%; once in, a daily close below +1.4%, under the Jan 15 high, proves it wrong. The case against, that there is a descending triangle, fails on the close that starts the buy.
